name: Jwt Decode
summary: Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) without verification. Use when the user provides a JWT string and wants to see its header, payload, or claims — e.g. "decode this JWT", "what's in this token", "inspect this JWT", "show me the claims", "parse this token". Also triggers on raw JWT strings (three base64url segments separated by dots).

name: Jwt Encode
summary: Create and sign JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for testing and development. Use when the user wants to generate, create, build, or sign a JWT — e.g. "create a JWT", "generate a test token", "sign this payload", "make a JWT with these claims", "build an access token". Supports HMAC, RSA, and ECDSA algorithms.

name: Jwt Validate
summary: Verify and validate JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) by checking signatures, expiration, claims, and structure. Use when the user wants to verify, validate, or check a JWT — e.g. "verify this token", "is this JWT valid", "check the signature", "validate this token against my JWKS", "is this token expired". Supports HMAC, RSA, and ECDSA with secrets, PEM keys, or JWKS endpoints.
